insights.text: Gulf Giants win 60% of our simulations.
Powerplay: Gulf Giants ~54 runs for 1.9 wickets; no wicket at all in 13% of simulations.
Gulf Giants's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; Fazalhaq Farooqi is the likeliest to take it (30%).
LS Livingstone is Gulf Giants's likeliest top scorer (24%), with a 37% chance of 30+.
Powerplay: MI Emirates ~44 runs for 1.8 wickets; no wicket at all in 15% of simulations.
MI Emirates's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; AJ Hosein is the likeliest to take it (20%).
N Pooran is MI Emirates's likeliest top scorer (28%), with a 41% chance of 30+.
S Joseph leads Gulf Giants's attack: 27% chance of 2+ wickets.
Rashid Khan leads MI Emirates's attack: 29% chance of 2+ wickets.
Key duel: Fazalhaq Farooqi dismisses Rahmanullah Gurbaz in 25% of simulations.
